grammar.purpose: Use natural adjective reduplication in context
grammar.explanation: Some adjectives repeat as AA or AABB to make a description vivid: 红红的、干干净净. The reduplicated form usually does not take 很 directly before it: 干干净净, not 很干干净净. This is not a rule that every adjective can be repeated. Use 清清楚楚 and 开开心心 for manner/state when appropriate; the meaning is not a numerical comparison.

examples.zh: 红红的围巾，是朋友送的。
examples.py: hóng hóng de wéi jīn , shì péng you sòng de .
examples.en: The red scarf was a gift from a friend.

examples.zh: 白色的衣服洗得干干净净。
examples.py: bái sè de yī fú xǐ de gān gān jìng jìng .
examples.en: The white clothes have been washed nice and clean.

examples.zh: 我们开开心心地去见朋友。
examples.py: wǒ men kāi kāi xīn xīn de qù jiàn péng you .
examples.en: We go happily to meet our friends.

commonMistakes.why: The vivid AABB form does not normally follow 很 here.

grammar.purpose: Describe a property or a comparison precisely
grammar.explanation: An adjective phrase can include degree or negation: 有点凉、不太重、很合适. It can describe a noun with 的 or act as a predicate without 是: 不太重的衣服; 这件衣服不太重. 很 often gives a neutral predicate rather than extreme intensity. In 价格不低, the property is price, not physical height or the owner’s status.

examples.zh: 晚上有点凉，带不太重的衣服。
examples.py: wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , dài bù tài zhòng de yī fú .
examples.en: It is a little cool at night; bring clothes that are not too heavy.

examples.zh: 这双鞋很合适，价格不低。
examples.py: zhè shuāng xié hěn hé shì , jià gé bù dī .
examples.en: These shoes fit well and are not cheap.

examples.py: lǜ sè de nà jiàn bǐ jiào qīng .
examples.en: That green one is relatively light.

commonMistakes.why: Use the adjective phrase directly as the neutral predicate; 是 would require an emphasis context.

grammar.explanation: 又…又… joins qualities that hold of the same referent: 又轻又短、又普通又舒服. It does not mean one quality belongs to one person and the other to someone else. Both may be positive or negative; the conjunction itself is not praise. Do not force contradictory qualities in the same sense without explaining different parts or circumstances.

examples.py: lǜ sè de yī fú yòu qīng yòu duǎn .
examples.en: The green garment is both light and short.

examples.zh: 这双鞋又重又贵，我今天不穿。
examples.py: zhè shuāng xié yòu zhòng yòu guì , wǒ jīn tiān bù chuān .
examples.en: These shoes are both heavy and expensive; I will not wear them today.

examples.zh: 这个样子又可爱又自然。
examples.py: zhè gè yàng zi yòu kě ài yòu zì rán .
examples.en: This look is both cute and natural.

commonMistakes.why: After each 又 use a compatible predicate, not a bare colour noun such as 蓝色.

lines.zh: 晚上见面，你穿什么？
lines.py: wǎn shang jiàn miàn , nǐ chuān shén me ?
lines.en: What are you wearing for tonight's meet-up?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还没想好。蓝色的还是绿色的？
lines.py: hái méi xiǎng hǎo . lán sè de hái shi lǜ sè de ?
lines.en: I haven't decided. Blue or green?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 晚上有点凉，蓝色那件长一点吧？
lines.py: wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , lán sè nà jiàn zhǎng yī diǎn ba ?
lines.en: It'll be cool tonight. Isn't the blue one longer?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。绿色的又轻又短，我带蓝色的。
lines.py: duì . lǜ sè de yòu qīng yòu duǎn , wǒ dài lán sè de .
lines.en: Yes. The green one's light and short. I'll bring the blue one.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那里面穿什么？
lines.py: nà lǐ miàn chuān shén me ?
lines.en: What will you wear underneath?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 白色的。黄色那件还没干。
lines.py: bái sè de . huáng sè nà jiàn hái méi gàn .
lines.en: White. The yellow one hasn't dried yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 鞋呢？我们还要走一会儿。
lines.py: xié ne ? wǒ men hái yào zǒu yī huì er .
lines.en: What about shoes? We'll be walking for a while.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 黑色的，走路舒服。还有朋友送的红色围巾。
lines.py: hēi sè de , zǒu lù shū fú . hái yǒu péng you sòng de hóng sè wéi jīn .
lines.en: Black ones. They're comfortable. And the red scarf my friend gave me.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好啊。到时候我也戴红色的。
lines.py: hǎo a . dào shí hou wǒ yě dài hóng sè de .
lines.en: Nice. I'll wear my red one too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你也有？那照片里可能认错我们。
lines.py: nǐ yě yǒu ? nà zhào piān lǐ kě néng rèn cuò wǒ men .
lines.en: You have one too? People might mix us up in photos.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 认鞋就行，我的是白色的。
lines.py: rèn xié jiù xíng , wǒ de shì bái sè de .
lines.en: Just look at the shoes. Mine are white.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，晚上见。
lines.py: xíng , wǎn shang jiàn .
lines.en: Okay. See you tonight.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: What I chose
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 晚上我和陈宇约好见朋友。出门前他问我穿什么，说晚上有点凉，让我带一件长一点的衣服。
lines.py: wǎn shang wǒ hé chén yǔ yuē hǎo jiàn péng you . chū mén qián tā wèn wǒ chuān shén me , shuō wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , ràng wǒ dài yī jiàn zhǎng yī diǎn de yī fú .
lines.en: Chen Yu and I planned to meet friends tonight. Before leaving he asked what I planned to wear, said it would be cool and suggested a longer layer.

lines.zh: 绿色那件又轻又短，蓝色的长一点。我把蓝色的放进包里，里面穿白色的。黄色那件还没干，只好留在家里。
lines.py: lǜ sè nà jiàn yòu qīng yòu duǎn , lán sè de zhǎng yī diǎn . wǒ bǎ lán sè de fàng jìn bāo lǐ , lǐ miàn chuān bái sè de . huáng sè nà jiàn hái méi gàn , zhǐ hǎo liú zài jiā lǐ .
lines.en: The green one was light and short; the blue one was longer. I packed the blue one and wore white underneath. The yellow one hadn't dried, so it stayed home.

lines.zh: 我穿黑色的鞋，也戴上朋友送的红色围巾。这双鞋虽然普通，走远路却很舒服，今天正好用得上。
lines.py: wǒ chuān hēi sè de xié , yě dài shàng péng you sòng de hóng sè wéi jīn . zhè shuāng xié suī rán pǔ tōng , zǒu yuǎn lù què hěn shū fú , jīn tiān zhèng hǎo yòng de shàng .
lines.en: I wore black shoes and the red scarf a friend had given me. The shoes were ordinary but comfortable for long walks, just right for today.

lines.zh: 到车站时，我先看到一条红色围巾，走近才发现是陈宇。他的鞋是白色的，还真的和我们说好的一样。
lines.py: dào chē zhàn shí , wǒ xiān kàn dào yī tiáo hóng sè wéi jīn , zǒu jìn cái fā xiàn shì chén yǔ . tā de xié shì bái sè de , hái zhēn de hé wǒ men shuō hǎo de yī yàng .
lines.en: At the stop I first saw a red scarf; closer up, I realised it was Chen Yu. His shoes were white, just as we'd said.

lines.zh: 朋友给我们拍照片，笑着说两条围巾的样子很可爱。陈宇问我是不是故意和他穿一样，我说是他先说也戴红色的。
lines.py: péng you gěi wǒ men pāi zhào piàn , xiào zhe shuō liǎng tiáo wéi jīn de yàng zi hěn kě ài . chén yǔ wèn wǒ shì bú shì gù yì hé tā chuān yī yàng , wǒ shuō shì tā xiān shuō yě dài hóng sè de .
lines.en: A friend took a photo and laughed that the two scarves looked cute. Chen Yu asked if I'd deliberately matched him. I said he'd been the one to choose red too.

lines.zh: 回家时风有点大，我从包里拿出蓝色的衣服。陈宇说幸好带了，我说对，还好它不重。
lines.py: huí jiā shí fēng yǒu diǎn dà , wǒ cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lán sè de yī fú . chén yǔ shuō xìng hǎo dài le , wǒ shuō duì , hái hǎo tā bù zhòng .
lines.en: It was windy on the way home, so I took out the blue layer. Chen Yu said it was lucky I'd brought it. Yes, I said, and luckily it wasn't heavy.

choices: They meet in matching red scarves and take a photo
They cancel because clothes are wet
They buy new shoes at the stop

lines.zh: 这双鞋是黑的。
lines.py: zhè shuāng xié shì hēi de .
lines.en: These shoes are black.

lines.zh: 天已经黑了，我们回去吧。
lines.py: tiān yǐ jīng hēi le , wǒ men huí qù ba .
lines.en: It's dark now. Let's go back.

lines.zh: 我有一双黑色的鞋。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu yī shuāng hēi sè de xié .
lines.en: I have a pair of black shoes.

lines.zh: 黑色的包是我的。
lines.py: hēi sè de bāo shì wǒ de .
lines.en: The black bag is mine.

lines.zh: 红的这件是朋友送的。
lines.py: hóng de zhè jiàn shì péng you sòng de .
lines.en: The red one was a gift from a friend.

lines.zh: 她的脸一下子红了。
lines.py: tā de liǎn yī xià zi hóng le .
lines.en: Her face suddenly went red.

lines.zh: 红色的围巾是朋友送的。
lines.py: hóng sè de wéi jīn shì péng you sòng de .
lines.en: The red scarf was a gift from a friend.

lines.zh: 我用红色的笔写了日期。
lines.py: wǒ yòng hóng sè de bǐ xiě le rì qī .
lines.en: I wrote the date with a red pen.

lines.zh: 你看，海是蓝的。
lines.py: nǐ kàn , hǎi shì lán de .
lines.en: Look, the sea is blue.

lines.zh: 今天的天很蓝，一朵云也没有。
lines.py: jīn tiān de tiān hěn lán , yī duǒ yún yě méi yǒu .
lines.en: The sky is blue today, without a single cloud.

lines.zh: 我今天穿蓝色的衣服。
lines.py: wǒ jīn tiān chuān lán sè de yī fú .
lines.en: I am wearing blue clothes today.

lines.zh: 请把蓝色的杯子给我。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ lán sè de bēi zi gěi wǒ .
lines.en: Please pass me the blue cup.

lines.zh: 这件绿的比那件黄的短。
lines.py: zhè jiàn lǜ de bǐ nà jiàn huáng de duǎn .
lines.en: This green one is shorter than that yellow one.

lines.zh: 春天一到，树就绿了。
lines.py: chūn tiān yī dào , shù jiù lǜ le .
lines.en: The trees turn green when spring comes.

lines.zh: 绿色的那件又轻又短。
lines.py: lǜ sè de nà jiàn yòu qīng yòu duǎn .
lines.en: The green one is both light and short.

lines.zh: 绿色的门旁边有一家小店。
lines.py: lǜ sè de mén páng biān yǒu yī jiā xiǎo diàn .
lines.en: There's a little shop beside the green door.

lines.zh: 这件黄的太重，今天不穿。
lines.py: zhè jiàn huáng de tài zhòng , jīn tiān bù chuān .
lines.en: This yellow one is too heavy; I will not wear it today.

lines.zh: 这片叶子已经黄了。
lines.py: zhè piàn yè zi yǐ jīng huáng le .
lines.en: This leaf has already turned yellow.

lines.zh: 黄色的衣服还没干。
lines.py: huáng sè de yī fú hái méi gàn .
lines.en: The yellow garment is not dry yet.

lines.zh: 那辆黄色的车停在路边。
lines.py: nà liàng huáng sè de chē tíng zài lù biān .
lines.en: That yellow car is parked by the road.

lines.zh: 朋友说这个样子很可爱。
lines.py: péng you shuō zhè gè yàng zi hěn kě ài .
lines.en: My friend says this look is cute.

lines.zh: 她家的小猫真可爱。
lines.py: tā jiā de xiǎo māo zhēn kě ài .
lines.en: Her kitten is so cute.

lines.zh: 只是朋友见面，穿普通的衣服就好。
lines.py: zhǐ shì péng you jiàn miàn , chuān pǔ tōng de yī fú jiù hǎo .
lines.en: It is just a meeting with friends; ordinary clothes are fine.

lines.zh: 我只要一个普通杯子，不用大的。
lines.py: wǒ zhǐ yào yī gè pǔ tōng bēi zi , bù yòng dà de .
lines.en: I just want an ordinary cup, not a big one.

lines.zh: 这双鞋对我很特别，是朋友送的。
lines.py: zhè shuāng xié duì wǒ hěn tè bié , shì péng you sòng de .
lines.en: These shoes are special to me; they were a gift from a friend.

lines.zh: 今天是他的生日，想做一点特别的菜。
lines.py: jīn tiān shì tā de shēng rì , xiǎng zuò yī diǎn tè bié de cài .
lines.en: It's his birthday today. I'd like to cook something special.

lines.zh: 这件衣服很轻，拿着方便。
lines.py: zhè jiàn yī fú hěn qīng , ná zhe fāng biàn .
lines.en: This garment is light and easy to carry.

lines.zh: 这个包很轻，里面只有一本书。
lines.py: zhè gè bāo hěn qīng , lǐ miàn zhǐ yǒu yī běn shū .
lines.en: This bag is light; there's only one book inside.

lines.zh: 绿色的比蓝色的短。
lines.py: lǜ sè de bǐ lán sè de duǎn .
lines.en: The green one is shorter than the blue one.

lines.zh: 这支笔太短了，不好拿。
lines.py: zhè zhī bǐ tài duǎn le , bù hǎo ná .
lines.en: This pen is too short to hold easily.

lines.zh: 这双鞋的价格不低。
lines.py: zhè shuāng xié de jià gé bù dī .
lines.en: These shoes are not cheap.

lines.zh: 桌子太低，我坐着不舒服。
lines.py: zhuō zi tài dī , wǒ zuò zhe bù shū fú .
lines.en: The table is too low. It's uncomfortable to sit here.

lines.zh: 鞋要合适，走路才舒服。
lines.py: xié yào hé shì , zǒu lù cái shū fú .
lines.en: Shoes should fit so walking is comfortable.

lines.zh: 进门先把鞋换了吧。
lines.py: jìn mén xiān bǎ xié huàn le ba .
lines.en: Change your shoes before coming in.

lines.zh: 这个样子和平时不一样。
lines.py: zhè gè yàng zi hé píng shí bù yī yàng .
lines.en: This look is different from usual.

lines.zh: 你小时候是什么样子？
lines.py: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu shì shén me yàng zi ?
lines.en: What did you look like as a child?

lines.zh: 白色的衣服洗得干干净净。
lines.py: bái sè de yī fú xǐ de gān gān jìng jìng .
lines.en: The white clothes have been washed nice and clean.

lines.zh: 白色的碗里是米饭。
lines.py: bái sè de wǎn lǐ shì mǐ fàn .
lines.en: The white bowl contains rice.

lines.zh: 穿得舒服，我很开心。
lines.py: chuān de shū fú , wǒ hěn kāi xīn .
lines.en: I am happy when dressed comfortably.

lines.zh: 收到你的消息，我很开心。
lines.py: shōu dào nǐ de xiāo xī , wǒ hěn kāi xīn .
lines.en: I was happy to hear from you.

lines.zh: 你喜欢什么颜色？
lines.py: nǐ xǐ huān shén me yán sè ?
lines.en: What colour do you like?

lines.zh: 这两个包的颜色不一样。
lines.py: zhè liǎng gè bāo de yán sè bù yī yàng .
lines.en: These bags are different colours.

lines.zh: 晚上有点凉，带一件衣服。
lines.py: wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , dài yī jiàn yī fú .
lines.en: It is a little cool in the evening; bring another layer.

lines.zh: 茶已经凉了，我再给你倒一杯。
lines.py: chá yǐ jīng liáng le , wǒ zài gěi nǐ dào yī bēi .
lines.en: The tea's gone cold. I'll pour you another cup.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二08, 二41, 二46. Native check: degree descriptions of colours, natural adjective reduplication, fit versus price, and the informal original verse. Dress expectations are specific to the fictional meeting, not a universal etiquette claim. Planned retrieval 二02 / 二75 / 二04 / 二11 / 二52: 我该带什么？你应该先问主人。, 六点半来，好吗？我带两瓶水，可以吗？, 我看了看题目，我们练习练习。, 这段录音听了两遍，答案检查了三次。, 看一场电影，去一回活动，老师拍三下手。, 看看，说一说，再练习练习。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Targeted HSK 2 naturalness review: natural 点了炒鸡蛋和一盘青菜 replaces generic dish wording, with precise passage glosses and aligned English; restaurant choice with a previous twenty-minute wait versus ten minutes today; two red scarves with different shoes, blue layer packed; printing only pages two/three at two and handing them over at three, Saturday event at two; activity-room discussion with a normal four-o’clock chime and Saturday three meeting. Removed assessment, identity and consent lectures inside friendly speech. All existing word/task IDs preserved. First examples retained where suitable, specific awkward examples fixed; every word also has an independently authored second context. Abstract education, behaviour and action vocabulary stays in separate examples rather than forced conversation. False statements checked against their own audio. Native flags: 为 beneficiary register, 取得成绩/同意 versus 拿到, educational 教师/教育/教学/中小学/年级 terms, 求 playful plea, 满意/不满 and 好处/坏处, adjective 色 forms, 站住 request strength, formal 受到/行动/行为 and colloquial 挺好. Native review pending. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
